no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was convened for this application.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the CERDELGA (eliglustat) NDA 205494 approval. Multiple FDA review documents state this explicitly: the Medical Review ("No Advisory Committee meeting was convened for this application"), the Office/Division Director Memo ("No Advisory Committee input was sought on this application"), the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review ("None"), and the Summary Review ("an advisory committee meeting was not convened"). Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
